changes.evidence: Two moves. (1) Age of Ultron ending: Thor leaves the Avengers at the new compound ('Farewell to the Avengers': he 'decided to leave Earth in the safe hands of the new Avengers') to search for the Infinity Stones alone; Thor: Ragnarok opens with him returning to Asgard (exposes Loki) before Hela sends him to Sakaar, so the Asgard stage is re-entered before Sakaar. (2) Avengers: Endgame: Banner and Rocket recruit him from New Asgard back to the Avengers ('Returning to the Avengers') for the Time Heist and the final battle; only afterwards does he hand the throne to Valkyrie and leave with the Guardians. Move (2) is the clear one; (1) mirrors the Bruce Banner Age of Ultron departure.

Wiki 'Assisting the Avengers' (cited to Avengers: Age of Ultron): after helping Thor at the Water of Sight, 'Selvig was recruited by the Avengers ... relocated to the Avengers Compound in Upstate New York to work as one of its key consultants'. He is seen at the new compound at the end of the film. S.H.I.E.L.D. had fallen by then (and in Thor: The Dark World he is a former consultant held in a London mental institution), so his S.H.I.E.L.D. stage should not run through Age of Ultron and beyond. He later left (Captain Marvel Prelude comic, not on file).

WandaVision episodes 5-6: after Wanda confronts S.W.O.R.D., Hayward has Darcy, Woo and Monica ordered off the Response Base ('Ejected from the Base'); they break back in and Darcy hacks Hayward's files against him. Later S.W.O.R.D. agents handcuff her to a Humvee and abandon her to the Hex, and in the finale she rams Hayward's Humvee and leaves before the FBI debrief. Her wiki affiliations do not even list S.W.O.R.D. Her work for S.W.O.R.D. ends inside WandaVision (same pattern as the Vision record's S.W.O.R.D. -> Independent).

This record's first title on file is Thor: The Dark World (it has no Thor or The Avengers step; those are on the separate T:loki file). His alliance with Thanos/the Chitauri is the 2012 Battle of New York, before any title on file: TDW opens with him already a prisoner in Asgard's dungeons, and the 2012 Loki in Avengers: Endgame is already in the Avengers' custody after his defeat. The stage uses a title (The Avengers) the record has no step for.

Thor: Ragnarok: thrown from the Bifrost, Loki lands on Sakaar 'weeks ago' and wins the Grandmaster's favor, staying at his side and accepting his commission to hunt down Thor and Hulk alongside Scrapper 142 (wiki 'Living on Sakaar', 'Challenging Valkyrie'). He then betrays the Grandmaster ('I've run out of favor with the Grandmaster') to join Thor's escape. Same Sakaar group the Thor, Valkyrie and Bruce Banner records use. Cumulative with the B fix above.

Laura's S.H.I.E.L.D. service as Agent 19 ended before Avengers: Age of Ultron, her first title on file; wiki: 'Laura decided to retire from S.H.I.E.L.D.' and Fury kept her out of the files and set up the Iowa farm (revealed in Hawkeye episode 6 via the watch). In Hawkeye she only helps Clint by phone and gets her old watch back; she does not rejoin. The S.H.I.E.L.D. stage is backstory and also out of story order. She is left with one group, so '(from the start)' applies.

VisionQuest episode 1: Vision works at Fiona Guthrie's Edinburgh pub The Old Selkie under the name Sherwood Ellis; Paladin's mercenaries attack the pub, kill Fiona in the crossfire and force him to flee. He does not go back. The rest of the series has him on the run with Tommy (Saint Mabyn's, Markridge gala, Madripoor). The MCU wiki also marks The Old Selkie as a former affiliation.

owner_calls.question: Should Clint's custody after Captain America: Civil War be a captured-and-held stage? He is locked in the Raft (U.S. government) until Steve breaks him out, and in Avengers: Infinity War he is under house arrest after taking a deal. Right now the record goes The Avengers -> Independent at Civil War, then The Avengers at Endgame. No group in the dataset stands for the Raft or the U.S. government's custody, and the same question applies to Wanda (and the T:wanda twin).
options: Keep as is (Raft and house arrest are statuses: Fugitive/Imprisoned)
Add a captor stage at Civil War (e.g. 'The Raft') before Independent, and another for the Infinity War house arrest
owner_calls.evidence: Civil War: captured at the Leipzig airport and held in the Raft until Steve frees him; Infinity War: Natasha says he took a deal and is under house arrest with his family.

owner_calls.question: In Avengers: Age of Ultron Wanda (and Pietro, A:pietro-maximoff) leave HYDRA to side with Ultron, then turn on him in Seoul and join the Avengers. No group in the dataset stands for Ultron's side, so the record goes straight from HYDRA to The Avengers. Should Ultron's side be a stage? A second question: in Civil War she is held in the Raft until Steve frees her (same as Clint).
options: Insert an Ultron-side stage at Avengers: Age of Ultron between HYDRA and The Avengers for Wanda and Pietro
owner_calls.evidence: Age of Ultron: the twins agree to help Ultron against Stark, then leave him once Wanda reads his plan to wipe out humanity. Their step text already says 'Leaving Ultron'.

owner_calls.question: Hill's last stage is The Avengers (Age of Ultron). The wiki says that in 2018 she 'left Stark Industries and joined Nick Fury' (cited to the Captain Marvel Prelude comic and Secret Invasion episode 5). Infinity War shows her only driving with Fury, and Secret Invasion has her working with Fury and Talos, not the Avengers. Fury's record has him as Independent then. Should she move to Fury's side, either in Infinity War or in Secret Invasion?
options: Keep The Avengers as her last stage
Add Independent at Avengers: Infinity War
Add Independent (or S.A.B.E.R.) at Secret Invasion
owner_calls.evidence: Wiki section 'Nick Fury's Crew' / 'Thanos' Victory': she leaves Stark Industries to join Fury before the Snap. The screen doesn't show her quitting the Avengers.

owner_calls.question: Valkyrie's first stage is Asgard at Thor: Ragnarok, but in that film her Asgard service, leading the Valkyrior against Hela, appears only in a flashback from centuries earlier. In the present she is Scrapper 142 on Sakaar from her first scene. Does a flashback inside an on-file title count (like Frigga's Love and Thunder flashback), or is this backstory to remove?
options: Keep Asgard -> Sakaar -> The Revengers -> Asgard
Remove the first Asgard stage (backstory): Sakaar -> The Revengers -> Asgard
owner_calls.evidence: Thor: Ragnarok: Loki's spell makes her relive the Massacre of the Valkyrie, after which she ended up on Sakaar. The wiki's sections 'Leading the Valkyrie' / 'Life on Sakaar'.
